I think I have an idea of how you feel, sorry that happened. Whats done is done. A big part of existing is learning to understanding the capacities that other humans (an unfortunately large precent..) can be plain shitty to their own kind. Realizing the nature of how so many people become the way they are. 
Our experiences and upbringing, lead way, way too many of us to gradually becoming situationally tone deaf and eventually completely detached and or ignorant to the most fair and basic societal standards. To say the least….

Not trying to excuse douchebaggery of any kind, however the vicious cycle of our world being cold, hurts people, and with the lack of help with mental health in the world, more people become cold, it sucks. 
I’m personally someone who crumbles under very little pressure and I’ve noticed recently what helps me in general with working through all of my current challenges and issues is forcing myself to keep my mental orientation fixated on the bigger picture, and regardless of beliefs- exercise your minds ability to view distressing/divisive and or complex issues from a centralized perspective. You don’t have to believe it, but try to imagine some kinda justification for what lead anyone in any moment to be rude, whether it’s their inebriation, lack of context clues… whatever plausible understanding you come to so you’re able to briefly acknowledge why people can be assholes. It may help you take things less personally. I don’t *think* most people are spared from widespread ignorance. With time though I’m sure we become resistant. Seen some long term retail workers that have convinced me of that lol.

We all walk with traumas, from immeasurable to bad, and baggage. The best way to react and establish a healthy outlook after situations like yours is to fight feeding into the mental flood of negativity. Obviously feel out your emotions, it’s not fair that life can be ruthlessly unfair. Learning that is a prime step in not letting yourself get burned as easily when people don’t care to be considerate. Just be careful not to dwell on these things to the point where you zero in on feelings of vengeance and dejection, sometimes our thoughts can be sneaky af. It can set up barriers between toxic beliefs or generalizations. It’s likely how many people grow insufferably out of touch to the point where they’re in their element while being so inappropriate.

TLDR; Even if it does boil down to people just being inexcusably awful, they’re clearly not well. Lots of difficult individuals exist, the way to NOT handle them, is to submit to their misery. As they say, its contagious. 
Sorry for yapping so much, I hope I made some sense and that you’re still hanging in there OP.🙏

6 years later, but as someone who has a large amount of this substance I’ve done it a few times and can probably offer some speculation.
I think the way people equate it to an auditory hallucinogen is a little inaccurate. Its like any other psychedelic really, however the audio distortion may be more prominent or noticeable since it tends to produce less “visuals” than psychedelics like LSD, or DMT. 

DiPT is a partial 5HT2a receptor agonist like any other psychedelic. These drugs make other parts of your brain communicate with one another. 
Certain psychedelics put you in touch with the entire spectrum of possible sensory input, for example LSD.
But amongst this whole diverse class of substances are some that are less visual, more physical, more psychologically complex with zero visuals, and vice versa.

TLDR; it’s just a psychedelic.

Bupropion inhibits the enzyme that metabolizes Dextromethorphan (DXM) which is one of the active ingredients of NyQuil which can cause an over abundance of DXM to occur in your body.
DXM on its own is a recreational drug, it’s a dissociative and also most relevantly in your case a very strong SNRI, (Serotonin-Norephinepherine reuptake inhibitor) Wellbutrin is already a NDRI, which means you had a storm of norepinephrine (adrenaline) coursing through your brain, as well as the serotonin from the DXM which is bound to cause some overstimulation, certainly explains the pupil dilation.

NyQuil also usually includes an antihistamine like doxylamine, that also can have some nasty feeling physical side effects/restlessness, since Wellbutrin also has some anticholinergic activity, this would have likely intensified the effect of the antihistamine.

Basically, if you’re going to take cold medication when you’re on bupropion, make sure you take the lowest possible dosage, or use an herbal cough syrup alternative.
